thread:
sam: quick flag — generate endpoint docs/examples still use "max_new_tokens" and sample responses show `choices[0].text`. runtime uses `max_tokens` and response is `outputs[].content`.

elaine: yikes. any specific files?

sam: found them in docs/api/generate.md, examples/generate.json, and openapi/components/examples/generate-response.json. also a curl in troubleshooting uses `X-Request-Id`. we standardized on `x-rw-request-id`.

jorge: i'll open a single PR to fix the param name, response samples, and curl header. will also sweep SDK snippets (py/js) for old imports/fields.

mina: for JS streaming: events changed from `type: 'delta'`/`delta.text` to `type: 'message'`/`message.parts`. i'll update snippet and add a small helper: `const text = message.parts.join('')`.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1024 — sam, jorge, mina requested for review :robot:

sam: quick note — examples/generate.json is used by docs-validate CI. i added a test case locally and it fails against the old `choices` shape, so this will catch regressions once PR is merged.

jorge: pushed OpenAPI fixes: replaced `choices` with `outputs`, set operationId for /generate to `generateText`, added `x-example-id` fields so anchors don't shift.

mina: pushed JS streaming + non-streaming changes. updated Node snippet to use `max_tokens`. also changed curl header to `-H \"x-rw-request-id: foo\"`.

elaine: Python quickstart still used `from redwood import Client`. updated to `from redwood_sdk import RedwoodClient` and adjusted constructor. added a migration paragraph under Breaking Changes.

sam: added a short migration note to the top of the generate doc: \"If you previously used `max_new_tokens`, switch to `max_tokens` and parse output from `outputs[].content`.\" kept wording opt-in.

mina: product-docs asked for a tiny Go example to show `resp.Outputs[0].Content`. added a 2-line snippet.

jorge: preview deployed: https://pr-1024.docs.redwood.ai — anchors preserved after adding explicit html id attributes.

docs-bot: docs-preview deploy queued for pr-1024 — will post URL when ready :rocket:

preview-bot: preview ready: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-1024 — sanity-check codeblock languages and anchors.

sam: validated codeblocks render. CI/docs-validate passed on my branch. requesting final reviews.

elaine: small wording nit addressed. merging after api review signoff.

release-bot: please include in release notes: parameter rename `max_new_tokens` -> `max_tokens`; response rename `choices` -> `outputs[].content`; header `X-Request-Id` -> `x-rw-request-id`; Python SDK import changed to `redwood_sdk.RedwoodClient`. :rocket:
